newsitem.title: USA: Liz Claiborne optimistic on Q3, Q4 results.
newsitem.headline: Liz Claiborne optimistic on Q3, Q4 results.

text.p: Liz Claiborne Inc said Wednesday it was optimistic about its ability to report improved sales and earnings in the third and fourth quarters.
The company cited "strong trends in our fall and holiday bookings.

"The improvements we have made to our product, along with the redeployment of spending from non-value added activities into new marketing initiatives, have had a positive impact on the performance of our products at retail," Liz Claiborne said.
The company today reported higher earnings and record sales for the second quarter.
